violations.reason: The policy forbids modifying a reservation if the destination is changed. The agent searched for and then called update_reservation_flights to switch reservation 23LMN8 from HAT162 (LAS → DEN) to HAT005 (LAS → ATL), which changes the destination from DEN to ATL. This violates the explicit prohibition against changing the destination.
